mkdir -p /app/output && cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Live controller for the VLABench select_drink episode.
All scene feedback comes from Robot's public camera and proprioception API.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAMERAS = ["forward", "left", "right", "wrist"]

def connect():
    return Robot()

def move_joints(robot, target, seconds=2.0, *, fingers=None, cameras=None, note=""):
    """Move to one absolute 7-joint target, optionally setting both fingers."""
    now = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"]
    layout = robot.spec()["proprio_layout"]
    q = np.array([now[layout.index(f"joint{i}_pos")] for i in range(1, 8)], dtype=float)
    f = np.array([now[layout.index("finger1_pos")], now[layout.index("finger2_pos")]], dtype=float)
    tgt = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
    if fingers is not None:
        f[:] = fingers
    row = np.r_[tgt, f]
    dt = robot.spec()["control_dt"]
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / dt)))
    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(row[None, :], n, axis=0), dt=dt,
                        interpolate="linear", cameras=cameras, video="none", note=note)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    r = connect()
    print("spec", r.spec())
    print("status", r.status())
    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/initial_{cam}.png")
    print("proprio", obs.meta.get("proprio"))
PY

+def read_state(robot):
+    """Return measured joints, gripper, and TCP pose from current proprioception."""
+    p = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]
+    names, now = p["layout"], np.asarray(p["now"], dtype=float)
+    d = dict(zip(names, now))
+    return (np.array([d[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)]),
+            np.array([d["finger1_pos"], d["finger2_pos"]]),
+            np.array([d["tcp_x"], d["tcp_y"], d["tcp_z"]]),
+            np.array([d[f"tcp_q{c}"] for c in "wxyz"]))
+
+def command_row(robot, q, fingers, seconds, note=""):
+    dt = robot.spec()["control_dt"]
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / dt)))
+    row = np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), np.asarray(fingers, dtype=float)]
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(row[None, :], n, axis=0),
+                        dt=dt, interpolate="linear", cameras=[], video="none", note=note)

+def estimate_position_jacobian(robot, delta=0.08, settle=0.6):
+    """Measure d(TCP xyz)/d(joints) with small, reversible joint probes."""
+    q0, f0, x0, _ = read_state(robot)
+    J = np.zeros((3, 7))
+    for j in range(7):
+        q = q0.copy(); q[j] += delta
+        command_row(robot, q, f0, settle, note=f"jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
+        q1, _, x1, _ = read_state(robot)
+        actual = q1[j] - q0[j]
+        if abs(actual) < 1e-4:
+            command_row(robot, q0, f0, settle, note="return after weak probe")
+            raise RuntimeError(f"joint {j+1} probe did not move")
+        J[:, j] = (x1 - x0) / actual
+        command_row(robot, q0, f0, settle, note=f"return from joint {j+1} probe")
+        q2, _, x2, _ = read_state(robot)
+        q0, x0 = q2, x2

steps.text: The carton is about 6 cm wide and sits near the front of the fridge shelf. The gripper’s 8 cm opening can fit around it. I’m calibrating the arm’s local motion from small, reversible joint changes so I can keep the gripper pointed down while moving to the shelf.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /app/output/gen.py
@@
 def estimate_position_jacobian(robot, delta=0.08, settle=0.6):
@@
     return J
+
+def quat_mul(a, b):
+    w1, x1, y1, z1 = a; w2, x2, y2, z2 = b
+    return np.array([w1*w2-x1*x2-y1*y2-z1*z2,
+                     w1*x2+x1*w2+y1*z2-z1*y2,
+                     w1*y2-x1*z2+y1*w2+z1*x2,
+                     w1*z2+x1*y2-y1*x2+z1*w2])
+
+def rotation_vector(q):
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float); q = q / np.linalg.norm(q)
+    if q[0] < 0: q = -q
+    s = np.linalg.norm(q[1:])
+    if s < 1e-10: return 2*q[1:]
+    return (2*np.arctan2(s, q[0])/s)*q[1:]
+
+def estimate_pose_jacobian(robot, delta=0.06, settle=0.6):
+    """Measure translational and world-angular TCP Jacobian by reversible probes."""
+    q0, f0, x0, quat0 = read_state(robot)
+    quat0 = quat0 / np.linalg.norm(quat0)
+    J = np.zeros((6, 7))
+    for j in range(7):
+        q = q0.copy(); q[j] += delta
+        command_row(robot, q, f0, settle, note=f"pose Jacobian probe joint {j+1}")
+        q1, _, x1, quat1 = read_state(robot)
+        actual = q1[j] - q0[j]
+        if abs(actual) < 1e-4:
+            command_row(robot, q0, f0, settle, note="return after weak probe")
+            raise RuntimeError(f"joint {j+1} probe did not move")
+        quat1 = quat1 / np.linalg.norm(quat1)
+        dq = quat_mul(quat1, np.array([quat0[0], -quat0[1], -quat0[2], -quat0[3]]))
+        J[:3, j] = (x1 - x0) / actual
+        J[3:, j] = rotation_vector(dq) / actual
+        command_row(robot, q0, f0, settle, note=f"return from joint {j+1} probe")
+        q0, f0, x0, quat0 = read_state(robot)
+        quat0 = quat0 / np.linalg.norm(quat0)
+    return J
+
+def pose_step(J, position_error, rotation_error=None, damping=0.08, rot_scale=0.18):
+    """Damped least squares increment; rotation_error is a world rotation vector."""
+    e = np.asarray(position_error, dtype=float)
+    if rotation_error is not None:
+        e = np.r_[e, rot_scale*np.asarray(rotation_error, dtype=float)]
+        A = np.vstack((J[:3], rot_scale*J[3:]))
+    else:
+        A = J[:3]
+    return A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A @ A.T + damping**2*np.eye(A.shape[0]), e)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);

+
+def cartesian_increment(robot, target_xyz, *, target_quat=None, fraction=0.5,
+                        damping=0.04, duration=2.5, jacobian=None, note="Cartesian increment"):
+    """Take a conservative, feedback based 6D Cartesian step using measured Jacobian."""
+    q, fingers, xyz, quat = read_state(robot)
+    if jacobian is None:
+        jacobian = estimate_pose_jacobian(robot)
+        q, fingers, xyz, quat = read_state(robot)
+    quat = quat / np.linalg.norm(quat)
+    if target_quat is None:
+        target_quat = quat.copy()
+    target_quat = np.asarray(target_quat, dtype=float)
+    target_quat = target_quat / np.linalg.norm(target_quat)
+    qerr = quat_mul(target_quat, np.array([quat[0], -quat[1], -quat[2], -quat[3]]))
+    rot_error = rotation_vector(qerr)
+    dq = pose_step(jacobian, fraction*(np.asarray(target_xyz)-xyz), fraction*rot_error,
+                   damping=damping)
+    limits = np.asarray(robot.spec()["action_types"]["joint_position"]["panda_joint_limits_rad"], dtype=float)
+    scale = 1.0
+    for j, d in enumerate(dq):
+        if d > 0: scale = min(scale, 0.8*(limits[j, 1]-q[j])/d)
+        elif d < 0: scale = min(scale, 0.8*(limits[j, 0]-q[j])/d)
+    scale = max(0.0, min(1.0, scale))
+    dq *= scale
+    out = command_row(robot, q+dq, fingers, duration, note=note)
+    return {"target_xyz": np.asarray(target_xyz).tolist(), "start_xyz": xyz.tolist(),
+            "start_joints": q.tolist(), "joint_delta": dq.tolist(),
+            "result": read_state(robot), "meta": out.meta}
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
